tagline: A leader in the design, engineering and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components for semiconductor capital equipment.
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified. Revenue is the primary tracking metric in this segment of outsourcing critical subsystems for the semiconductor industry.

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales amount of fluid subsystems for semiconductor equipment.
kpis.description: Revenue increased by 11.6% in 2025 to $947.7M, driven by strong demand from key customers (Lam Research, Applied Materials) in the etch and deposition markets.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth in 2025 despite market volatility.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined to 9.3% in 2025 from 12.2% in 2024, due to restructuring charges and cost pressures.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin turned to -4.1% in 2025 from -0.9% in 2024, impacted by $35M in restructuring charges related to site closures in Scotland and Korea.
kpis.signal: Operating loss in 2025 after near breakeven in 2024.

kpis.name: Research and Development (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses relative to sales.
kpis.description: R&D spending remains stable at around 3.5% of revenue, consistent with a business model focused on engineering and manufacturing rather than radical software or hardware innovation.
kpis.signal: Moderate level of R&D investment for a subsystem supplier.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on production equipment and facilities.
kpis.description: Capex increased to $45M in 2025, supported by expansion of high-volume sites and transition of operations from Scotland and Korea.
kpis.signal: Higher capex to support relocation and ramp-up of high-volume sites.

kpis.name: Customer Concentration
kpis.explanation: Share of sales generated by the two largest customers.
kpis.description: 76% of sales in 2025 were generated by Lam Research and Applied Materials, reflecting the high consolidation in the semiconductor equipment market.
kpis.signal: High dependence on two major customers (Lam Research, Applied Materials).

risks.title: Cyclicality of the semiconductor equipment industry
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in Item 1A and is described as impacting operating results. The industry is inherently cyclical, with significant demand fluctuations, representing a major risk for a company dependent on this sector for over 90% of its revenue.

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified in Item 1A, highlighting that two customers accounted for 76% of sales in 2025. Dependence on such a small number of major customers is a significant risk.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Conditions and Global Trade Tensions
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A explicitly mentions risks related to the global regulatory and business environment, including tariffs and national security measures. Uncertainty in these areas is described as having potential material impact.

risks.title: Export Controls and Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A highlights the expansion and tightening of U.S. government export controls, particularly toward China. These controls create market uncertainty and could reduce demand.

risks.title: Technological Evolution and Increasing Complexity
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A describes the constant evolution and growing complexity of semiconductors and associated equipment. The company must keep pace with these changes to remain competitive, requiring ongoing R&D investment.

ai_positioning.summary: The company ICHR does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
